ValidationRule.description: A paid or partially paid installment must record when and how much was received.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Paid"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Partially Paid")), OR(ISBLANK(Paid_Date__c), ISBLANK(Amount_Paid__c), Amount_Paid__c <= 0) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter the amount paid and paid date for a paid or partially paid installment.
